lines: Mind pellucid, Master — steppest thou within, or at thy stepping
l4.sanskrit_cite: prasanne manasi svāmin kiṃ tvaṃ niviśase kim u tvatpraveśāt prasīdet tad iti dolāyate janaḥ

reads_against.argmap: When mind is clear, O master — do you enter, or from your entering does it clear. → Entering vs clearing — the person swings between.
c1_essence: Step in or self-clear? Man dangles; oversight alone decides.
reads_against.l2: Mind pellucid, master — step you in, or at your stepping does it clear? So dangles man.
l3: Mind pellucid, Master — steppest thou within, or clears it
at thy stepping? Man dangles thus.
reads_against.t1: When mind is clear, O master — do you enter, or from your entering does it clear — thus the person swings.
